about: Raw source snapshots for the harbor district, written by scripts/harbor/fetch.mjs (npm run harbor:fetch). Vector files are gzipped JSON in lon/lat (EPSG:4326) rounded to 7 decimals and sorted by a stable id; sha256 and bytes are of the uncompressed content.

boston-curbs.geojson.gz.paging: returnIdsOnly=true, then objectIds POSTed back in batches of 500
boston-curbs.geojson.gz.license: PDDL-1.0 (Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License; City of Boston open data)
notes: layer 13 (also named "Curbs") returned exactly the same 268 features within DETAIL (same OBJECTIDs, TYPE and geometry), so it is not saved separately

notes: POLY_TYPE: FEE 1256, (null) 1
id 97676 (MAP_PAR_ID "MASSGIS") is not a parcel but the city-wide remainder: a polygon whose holes are the parcels, i.e. the street right-of-way as one feature; skip or clip it when baking
open harbour water lies in no polygon, but wharf parcels reach well out over the water, so parcels are no land/water mask
id 97676 alone has 443623 of the file's 457025 vertices (204 polygons, 4525 rings) and spans lon -71.1847..-70.9943, lat 42.2320..42.3960, far past the bbox

dem.i16.gz.source: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) bare-earth DEM, via the 3DEPElevation ImageServer
dem.i16.gz.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work: USGS 3D Elevation Program)
dem.i16.gz.tiling: 1 tile(s) of at most 8000×8000 px (the service's limit)
notes: 1316×1294 Int16 centimetres NAVD88 (header: dem.json); count is pixels
elevations -3.01 m to 11.27 m; 0 nodata pixels
adjustAspectRatio=false matters: by default the service keeps pixels square in degrees and silently grows the latitude extent (to 42.35278..42.36852 for DETAIL), misplacing every row

osm-coast.json.gz.source: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (Overpass API 0.7.62.11 87bfad18)
osm-coast.json.gz.license: ODbL-1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution required, share-alike for derived databases)
notes: raw Overpass JSON elements sorted by type (node, way, relation) then id; timestamp/version/changeset/user/uid dropped, tags sorted by key
out geom is unclipped: ways that cross the COAST bbox are complete
natural=coastline: 35 ways chain into 4 open line(s); every open end lies outside the bbox, so the coastline runs unbroken across it

osm-detail.json.gz.source: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (Overpass API 0.7.62.11 87bfad18)
osm-detail.json.gz.license: ODbL-1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors; attribution required, share-alike for derived databases)
notes: raw Overpass JSON elements sorted by type (node, way, relation) then id; timestamp/version/changeset/user/uid dropped, tags sorted by key
out geom(bbox) clips geometry to DETAIL: a way keeps every id in `nodes`, but `geometry` holds null for nodes past the first one outside the bbox
5224 of 5287 relation way-members lie wholly outside the bbox and carry an empty (or all-null) geometry
